findings.reason: Verified at EventManager.ts:118-119: with null or [] destinationCalendar the destructured value is undefined, and .integration is read without ?. whenever location is Google Meet, so the booking throws where the old code fell back to Cal Video.

The diff shows !IS_TEAM_BILLING_ENABLED && {slug} became IS_TEAM_BILLING_ENABLED ? {slug} : {}, inverting the condition; upgrade.ts:66 publishes from requestedSlug, so billing-enabled orgs get published unpaid and self-hosted orgs get no slug.

The diff changes the non-calendar branch to credentialId: isCalendarType ? result.credentialId : undefined, so video references are saved without a credentialId, which the later update and delete lookups depend on.

createAllCalendarEvents passes the full destinationCalendar array to every host's createEvent, and Office365, Lark and CalDAV all read index 0, so a second collective host writes to the main host's calendar id.

Verified at googlecalendar CalendarService.ts:254-256 and 315-317: when externalCalendarId is falsy the find compares cal.externalId to that falsy value, so it returns undefined; update then passes an undefined calendarId and delete falls back to primary, where the old code used the destination's externalId.

When neither event type nor organizer has a destination calendar, evt.destinationCalendar is null (handleNewBooking ~line 1067), so the optional-chained push is a no-op and collective members' calendars are silently dropped.

The recurring deletion block now sits inside the per-reference loop, so the organizer's events are deleted once per calendar reference, with the same first-ref uid each time, and the other hosts are still not handled.

The else branch in createAllCalendarEvents filters the organizer's calendarCredentials by integration type, so a member destination with no credentialId creates a copy on the organizer's calendar; the path is concrete but depends on a member row without credentialId.

Verified that the empty dynamicUserList check now throws a plain Error that the catch turns into a 500, and that the instanceof HttpError check is dead inside that try; the impact is a changed error status on a rare input, and the organization.slug claim is unverified.
